lines.zh: 我一边走一边喊自己的名字
lines.en: I walk along shouting my own name.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很乱，像在跳舞
lines.en: My steps are a mess, like dancing.

lines.zh: 我从一丛草里直冲过去
lines.en: I barge straight through a clump of grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着一个圈走，又回到原处
lines.en: I walk a circle and end where I began.
I move fast, with no direction.

lines.zh: 我把脚下的石子踢得乱飞
lines.en: I kick the pebbles flying.
I look left and right as I go.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的动作还乱
lines.en: My shadow is messier than my movements.
I stop dead halfway through a charge.

lines.zh: 我转身太快，自己绊了一下
lines.en: I turn too fast and trip myself.
I move as if pushed along.

lines.zh: 我撞开一丛灌木，头也不回
lines.en: I burst through brush without looking back.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边拍自己的腿
lines.en: I slap my own leg as I walk.

lines.zh: 我在原地转了个圈，然后走
lines.en: I spin once, then walk.

lines.zh: 我站着，嘴里还在念名字
lines.en: I stand, still saying my name.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，眼睛不知道看哪
lines.en: My head tilts; my eyes aim nowhere.
I shudder once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，又忘了要做什么
lines.en: I raise a hand and forget why.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，忘了自己要喊什么。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open; I forgot what I meant to shout.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个方向看了很久
lines.en: I stare one way for a long time.

lines.zh: 我把手在空中抓了两下
lines.en: I claw the air twice.
I laugh once, abruptly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹲下去，又站起来
lines.en: I crouch slowly and rise again.
My finger draws circles in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我数了一下自己有几种声音
lines.en: I count how many sounds I can make.

lines.zh: 我忽然对着天上喊了一句
lines.en: I shout at the sky, suddenly.
I reach up and scratch my neck.

lines.zh: 我把一边的肩膀抬得老高
lines.en: I hike one shoulder up high.
I turn my whole face to you.

lines.zh: 我念了你的名字，念错了
lines.en: I say your name, and get it wrong.
I come far too close.
My breathing is a little fast.
I reach out and pull back.

lines.zh: 你这么站着，我有点想撞
lines.en: Standing like that makes me want to ram you.
I walk one circle around you.

lines.zh: 我不太懂你为什么在这里
lines.en: I do not quite see why you are here.
My head is bigger than my body.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走近，不看脚下
lines.en: I come nearer without watching my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬手指了指你，又指自己
lines.en: I point at you, then at myself.
My mouth moves, with no words.
I go quiet, suddenly.
I turn small circles beside you.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音很难听
lines.en: I cry out, and it sounds awful.
I back two steps into a tree.
I clutch my head and curl up.
I shudder, then stand again.
The name in my mouth breaks off.
I back off, swaying.

lines.zh: 我把手放在被打的地方
lines.en: I put a hand where I was hit.
I pull my neck in.
I groan, and it sounds bad.
I crouch, then slowly rise.
Does that thing in your hand make a sound?
I track it, head turning with it.
May I take it? I took it.
I will not eat it; I just want to hold it.
It is more interesting than my name.
Give it and I will not ram you.
I reach out and just take it.
I shake it to hear the sound.

lines.zh: 我顶着它给你看，像顶帽子。
lines.en: I balance it on my head like a hat to show you.
I forget it is in my hand.
We collide and I laugh.
I bounce off and charge back in.
You hit my shoulder, and it is hard.
I grab your clothes and hold.
We spin once before parting.

lines.zh: 我一撞就忘了为什么撞
lines.en: I hit you and forget why.

lines.zh: 我一撞就把你当墙靠着
lines.en: I bump you and lean on you like a wall.
My head meets your shoulder.
We burst a heap of dry grass apart.
The hit turns me around.
She says her name constantly too.
We shout at each other, neither stopping.
We wander together.
Her voice is louder than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，晃来晃去
lines.en: We stand side by side, swaying.
We turn circles at each other.

lines.zh: 她学我念名字，念得不像
lines.en: She copies my name, badly.

lines.zh: 我们一起撞翻了同一个桶
lines.en: We knock over the same barrel.

lines.zh: 她把头靠在我肩上，很响地吸气
lines.en: She leans on my shoulder and breathes loudly.

lines.zh: 我们一起往同一个方向走错
lines.en: We both walk the wrong way together.
I bend and my head hits the ground first.
I grab three times before it comes up.
I hold it up and shout.

lines.zh: 我把这东西抱在怀里，忘了放哪。
lines.en: I hug this thing to my chest and forget where it goes.
It falls, and I pick it up again.
I crouch and grab with both hands.
I pick it up and drop it.
I press it to my chest.

lines.zh: 我捡了两次，都是同一个
lines.en: I pick it up twice, the same thing.

lines.zh: 我举着它转圈，自己也晕了。
lines.en: I hold it overhead and spin until I'm dizzy.
I stop saying my name.
My eyes fix.
I charge at you.
I stop halfway.
I start saying my name again.
My feet stop short.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，我看见你了
lines.en: I see you, I see you.
My shoulder pushes forward.
I charge one step your way.
I look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 我抓住自己的头，好像在想
lines.en: I grip my own head, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 我又开始念自己的名字
lines.en: I start saying my name again.
I am not fast, but I do not stop.
I hit a tree, go around, and chase again.
I keep shouting behind you.
I knock a barrel over.

lines.zh: 我和你之间的距离在缩短
lines.en: The distance between us is shrinking.
I slip, and get up again.

lines.zh: 我绕了个大圈，还是朝你
lines.en: I take a wide loop, still toward you.
I hit a wall and turn to charge again.
I have shouted my voice hoarse.
I crash through grass toward you.
I stop for one breath.
I charge again from a stop.

lines.zh: 我低着头冲过去，撞在你腰上。
lines.en: I charge headfirst and ram your waist.
I swat you once.
I catch your sleeve.
I hit you and sit down myself.
I ram your chest with my head.
I strike your shoulder.
I grab you and pull back.
I miss and fall to the ground.
I get up and ram again.

lines.zh: 我这一下有点重，我自己也疼
lines.en: That one was heavy, and it hurt me too.

lines.zh: 我从一个很响的地方出现
lines.en: I appear out of somewhere very loud.
I shout my name first.

lines.zh: 我把周围的草都踩倒了
lines.en: I flatten the grass around me.

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，找不到方向
lines.en: I turn half around, unable to find a direction.
Something clatters by my feet.
I stand here and start reciting.
I shout three times first.
I appear over a heap of trampled grass.
I turn a full circle before spotting you.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土被踢得到处都是
lines.en: Dirt is kicked everywhere around me.
I raise a hand as if greeting you.

lines.zh: 我开始念名字，音节很乱
lines.en: I start reciting my name, all jumbled.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的身上，我跑来跑去
lines.en: Fire catches me and I run in circles.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，一直喊
lines.en: I tumble downhill, still shouting.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，名字喊不出来
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and the name will not come.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹得转了三圈
lines.en: The blast spins me three times.

lines.zh: 有东西扎在我身上，我低头看
lines.en: Something sticks in me; I look down.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的嘴闭上了
lines.en: That force shuts my mouth.

lines.zh: 我空着肚子，喊得没力气
lines.en: Empty, my shouting has no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我跳了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and I jump.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我还在喊名字
lines.en: The ground is gone and I am still shouting my name.
